mentions.name: Verse Draft
mentions.description: This web-based application is an all-in-one writing studio where fiction writers can keep all the details for an entire universe in one place while crafting stories, novels, movie scripts, TV series, or stage plays. It offers a limited AI virtual assistant that functions only as a sounding board for discussing stories and world-building without writing anything for the user, and it can also be used entirely without AI tools.
mentions.problem: Fiction writers need a single place to keep all the details for an entire universe while writing, plus AI support that acts as a sounding board without writing for them.
mentions.audience: Fiction writers working on stories, novels, movie scripts, TV series, or stage plays.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've just released in beta, a web-based application called Verse Draft: https://versedraft.com

I wanted to create an all-in-one writing studio where fiction writers can keep all the details for an entire universe in one place while crafting stories, novels, movie scripts, TV series, or stage plays.
